profile.headline: Developer / SQA
profile.summary: Over four plus years of experience as an information system engineer. Experience in software development and software quality assurance. Proven ability to work under pressure, working in groups and working alone. I adapt quickly to any environment, a fast learner with the goal to use my knowledge and skills to make your system work smoother and better with quality being the goal. I am willing to relocate and travel.

positions.title: Java Web Developer
positions.description:
• Update, maintain and change current web applications.

• Develop new java code and execute new features through business requirements.

• Implement and test new java web codes.

• Debug and develop patches for identified and reported problems.

• Record new java code and modify existing code.

positions.title: Credit Portfolio Analyst
positions.description:
* Provide support in developing reports, analysis, indicators and analytic models for credit 
portfolios. 

* Support the different areas of risk and compliance vice in the development of tools to automate processes and obtaining information from the databases of the various systems. Those tools were 
developed in asp.net, C# and MSSQLSERVER 2012

company.name: Asociación Popular de Ahorros y Préstamos

positions.title: Software Quality Assurance
positions.description:
* Analyze and document test during cycle software quality. 

* Validate use cases following the schemes proposed by analysts based on the requirements of 
applications or system. 

* Visual application development, maintain and debug the code according to technical specifications. (ASP.NET, C#, SQLSERVER 2008, Crystal Report). 

* Detect and report defects in the development iterations of Web / Desktop applications and visual. 

* Detect and report defects in the iterations of development of visual applications (Web / Desktop) 
and Central Core AS-400, suggest and propose improvements based on the requirements. 

* Prepare test environments according to the requirement of the same. 

* Suggest improvements to procedures and systems analysts in gathering requirements. 

* Experience as an operator of AS400 (preparation of work environments, manipulation of objects, 
libraries, archives and program sources). 

* Management Siebel CRM 8.

* Managing Core Banking systems involving customer daily. Credit cards, bank accounts, loans, 
certificates and administrative processes for conducting tests.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
* Writing server side code using WinForms / ASP.NET WebForms in C#. 

* Used ADO.NET to access data in an existing databases in SQL Server 2008.

positions.title: Software Analyst
positions.description:
* Develop use cases.

* Rising requirements for development.

positions.title: Desktop Support Technician
positions.description:
. Make sure the computers are working properly. 

· Installation and configuration of softwares.

· Users support.

· Application development C# WinForms.

· Migration of all data from Excel to SQLServer 2008 (DTS).

· Connect existing applications to the new Data Base.

· Maintenance and updates to existing applications.
